primary_held_development_metric: Mean eight-bin preaction Brier, source-native step-weighted, accompanied by independent reset cluster means and paired source-cluster delta counts; do not infer population CI from correlated individual source action steps
strict_development_history_go: On EACH independently authored source, converged recurrent helddevelopment mean8bit Brier is >=0.003 lower than the strongest trained current-only model of logistic, Bayesian, and separately TRAINED eight-unit nonrecurrent; >=8/12 independent helddevelopment reset clusters recurrent wins against that strongest current-only control; same-weight hidden-state reset increases error >=0.001; and recurrent TRAINING mean seed Brier <= fitted current-only logistic training Brier+0.01.
science_admission: NO_GO even if this DEV hypothesis passes: both source TASKS known during training, no unseen independently first-used new source families, model total budgets unequal and no Ygg-native learned control.

negative_rule: If frozen DEV criterion fails, preserve all positive and negative outcomes and stop this exact hypothesis without retuning on held development data. A future independent evaluation needs independent preregistration and new original source families.
